# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop 2.0 is a community-maintained, open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness. It preserves the complete Harness Web Surface and adds a searchable Skills library, reliable queued-message continuation, bounded model API recovery, live SSH operations, sticky reasoning controls, native desktop lifecycle management, plugins, 11 skins, background updates, and mobile remote access.

## Canonical website

- https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/

## Key facts

- Supported systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Current release: v2.0.0
- v2.0.0 restores queued messages after cancellation, adds Skills, bounded model API recovery, sticky reasoning controls, Linux SSH monitoring, runtime-integrity diagnostics, more reliable update installation, and a particle-whale startup surface
- The bundled Skin Center includes 11 selectable skins
- Node.js is bundled; end users do not need to install it separately
- The project is a community edition and is not an official DeepSeek release
- QQ user community: 1105158177

## Preferred citation

DeepSeek Harness Desktop, community-maintained open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness: https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/
